meta.title: Feature hub
meta.description: An aggregator that carries several pluggable feature components in one bundle. The bundle takes over the left sidebar's workspace browsing region and adds a Recent tasks group above the project groups: one row per project for that project's most recently active session, all rows ordered by activity time descending. The group collapses and expands like a workspace group (expanded by default, state remembered), and selecting a row opens the session. It lists five sessions by default; Settings → Feature hub changes that (1–50), and running or waiting sessions are listed on top of the limit instead of being cut by it. Below it the project groups, their session rows, session search, new session, and add workspace remain; session rows keep their hover archive/pin buttons, and right-click or Shift+F10 still opens the native session menu (rename, fork, copy id, archive, pin). This version does not provide the view-options menu (group by / order / archived filter), drag reordering, hover cards, or remote content search, and workspace rename/delete is missing because the replaced browser rendered those dialogs. It also adds a branch chip to the composer tool row: it always names the branch the session directory is on (hidden outside a git repository), opens a searchable switcher for local branches, can create and switch to a new branch, and marks uncommitted changes with a small amber dot. Disabling the plugin restores the shipped sidebar without touching session data.
